from pyspark.sql.types import StructType
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, regexp_replace, explode
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

# Azure storage access info
blob_account_name = 'adlsfhirnonprod'
blob_container_name = 'bronze'
blob_relative_path = '1tb'
linked_service_name = 'lsadlsfhirnonprod'

blob_sas_token = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(linked_service_name)

# Allow Spark to access Storage remotely

wasb_path = 'wasbs://%s@%s.blob.core.windows.net/%s' % (blob_container_name, blob_account_name, blob_relative_path)
spark.conf.set('fs.azure.sas.%s.%s.blob.core.windows.net' % (blob_container_name, blob_account_name), blob_sas_token)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + blob_relative_path + "/Observation/year=2016/"
silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + blob_account_name + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + blob_relative_path

observationSchemaFile = bronzePath
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(bronzePath)

df = df.withColumn("subject",regexp_replace("subject.reference","Patient/","")).withColumn("encounter",regexp_replace("encounter.reference","Encounter/",""))
df = df.withColumnRenamed("id","observation_id")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("subject","patient_id_reference")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("encounter","encounter_id_reference")

df = df.select(
    "observation_id","resourceType","issued","status","patient_id_reference","encounter_id_reference","effectiveDateTime",
    "valueQuantity.code","valueQuantity.system","valueQuantity.unit","valueQuantity.value","valueString").toDF(*(
    "observation_id","resourceType","issued","status","patient_id_reference","encounter_id_reference","effectiveDateTime",
    "valueQuantity_code","valueQuantity_system","valueQuantity_unit","valueQuantity_value","valueString"
    ))

df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").save(silverPath + "/Observation_main/")
